Hi All,

My husband (Israeli) of 11 years and I (American) are filling out the initial online application for the visa from within Israel and ran into a few issues. Hoping someone could share some insight! 

2. The form M6 is marked as a requirement and the system doesn’t let you move forward without uploading it. However, my husband is already registered as married and does not need to change his personal status in Israel. Did anyone run into this? Is uploading the little paper that comes with the teudat zeut that states “married” a reasonable way forward? 

3. Personal Status Certificate- has anyone gotten this document from the US while being physically in Israel? I am very confused about what this documents actually is! It seems like some states don’t have a standardized form for this? Is this actually two documents - one confirming that I was single 11 years ago when I got married and one confirming that I am still married? Any info about how to approach this would be greatly appreciated!

Thanks!
